title: Smith Lock File
description: Generated by smith sync and checked in. Pins the project types this repo uses and their integrity hashes. Never hand-edit.

version.description: File-format version. Always 1 for this schema.

types.description: Pinned project types, keyed by name@version. Hash must match the registry sidecar and the installed copy in ~/.smith (chain of custody enforced by smith).

registry.description: Registry this type came from (name from .smith/repo.yml).

hash.description: Must match the registry sidecar and the installed copy in ~/.smith. A mismatch at load time is a hard error prompting `smith sync` — never a silent content swap.
